title: Understanding the Intercept Term
text: The intercept term in a linear regression model represents the expected value of the response variable when all predictors are zero. Consider how centering the data might affect this term.

hintAnswer: The intercept becomes the mean of the response variable.
title: Effect of Centering on the Intercept
text: When data is mean-centered, what happens to the intercept term in the regression model?
choices: The intercept becomes the mean of the response variable.

title: Analyzing the Objective Function
text: Look at the objective functions in the images. Notice how the design matrix is used in each case. How does centering affect the calculation of the intercept?

hintAnswer: The mean of the response variable.
title: Intercept in Mean-Centered Data
text: In the mean-centered version of the data, what does the intercept term represent?
choices: The mean of the response variable.
The sum of the response variable.
The variance of the response variable.
